name: eternaweb_trainpool_v1
purpose: TRAINING-side puzzles for a Stage C repair model; disjoint from and dissimilar to every eternaweb_dev_v1 target and every test-side audit structure.

rules.eligibility: as eternaweb_dev_v1 (structure, length, pairs, hairpins, distinct, not Eterna100 id)
rules.exclusion: normalized edit distance <= 0.2 to any evaluation target, test-side structure or accepted puzzle

source.paper: Gautam, Dai, Zhou, Xie, Mathews, Huang 2026, arXiv:2602.12470
